meta.title.zh: 陽明交大應用數學系 — 吳弘叡
meta.title.en: NYCU Department of Applied Mathematics — Hong-Ruei Wu

meta.description.zh: 吳弘叡個人網站中，陽明交大應用數學系的系所介紹頁面，收錄歷史沿革、人員組成與研究領域。
meta.description.en: Department introduction page for NYCU's Department of Applied Mathematics on Hong-Ruei Wu's personal website — history, faculty, and research areas.

the-nycu-department-of.zh: 陽明交大應用數學系成立於1994年，致力於培養具備數學基礎及應用能力的學生，並推動跨學科的合作與創新。
the-nycu-department-of.en: The NYCU Department of Applied Mathematics was established in 1994, aiming to cultivate students with a solid mathematical foundation and applied skills, and to promote interdisciplinary collaboration and innovation.

the-department-has-over.zh: 本系擁有30多位專任教授，涵蓋純數學、應用數學、計算數學等多領域，並積極參與國際合作與學術交流。
the-department-has-over.en: The department has over 30 full-time professors covering pure mathematics, applied mathematics, computational mathematics, and other fields, actively participating in international collaborations and academic exchanges.

research-areas-include-discrete.zh: 本系研究涵蓋離散數學、數據科學、統計學、數值分析、優化理論等多個領域，與多個國際頂尖大學保持緊密合作。
research-areas-include-discrete.en: Research areas include discrete mathematics, data science, statistics, numerical analysis, and optimization theory, maintaining close collaboration with leading universities worldwide.

our-graduates-are-widely.zh: 本系畢業生廣泛分佈於學術界與工業界，其中多位校友於國際知名企業及研究機構擔任重要職務，並在數學與科技領域取得卓越成就。
our-graduates-are-widely.en: Our graduates are widely represented in academia and industry, with many alumni holding important positions in internationally renowned companies and research institutions, achieving significant accomplishments in mathematics and technology fields.
